summary: A tight suspense beat with a clean three-step shape: command, fearful question, dry release. Sayed’s final line gives character and restrained humour without puncturing the danger.

performance.delivery: Hiss the order toward the neighbouring pits without lifting the head. Keep it clipped and forceful enough to stop an involuntary movement despite the approaching engine.
Let the question escape only after the engine fades. Adel is still rigid in the pit and barely has enough breath to form the word.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.emotion: grim reassurance hidden as dry humour
performance.delivery: Answer without looking toward Adel and without relaxing. The first half acknowledges the danger; the second quietly cuts through the younger soldier’s panic.

lines.text: لَوْ كَانِتْ شَافِتْنَا… كُنْتْ عِرِفْتْ لِوَحْدَكْ.
